form_title: PRACTICAL ASSESSMENT – OFF ROAD AND DESERT
form_subtitle: ADNOC Off-road and Desert Assessment form
assessment_guidance:
Centre’s must ensure that learners receive all theoretical learning specified in each Outcome prior to any practical assessment taking place.
Following theoretical learning and demonstration of practical exercises by the centre, learners will be observed undertaking practical exercises covering all the criteria specified in Outcomes 1 and 12 of Unit 5.
Learners must successfully complete all practical exercises to achieve this Unit.
Learners will drive pre-determined routes, allowing them the opportunity to practice and perform all required practical criteria.
Records of assessment referencing all outcomes must be securely maintained.
Instructors must conduct comprehensive demonstrations of all unit 5 criteria, including a commentated drive.
source_legend: Source of Evidence: O – Observation  S – Simulation  Q – Questioning  W – Witness

criteria.outcome: 2. Driver Commentary
criteria.criterion:
Learners must conduct a continuous commentary drive for a minimum of 5 minutes. Commentary should cover:
1. Mirrors
2. Signals
3. Position
4. Speed
5. Hazard identification
